brief: Czech trade and business press is a genuinely productive layer for CZ payments intelligence: E15, Měšec.cz, Peníze.cz, Aktuálně.cz and Banky.cz publish dated, quotable national figures on card counts, contactless share, ATM fleets and terminal acceptance, almost always sourced from SBK and ČNB, while HN, Ekonom and the specialist magazine Bankovnictví supply the executive interviews and deal reporting where competitive and fleet detail actually surfaces. Retail trade titles (Zboží&Prodej, Retail News) add the merchant-side POS view that bank-centric outlets miss, and Lupa.cz / CzechCrunch cover fintech, acquiring economics and merchant fees. The binding constraint is access, not existence: the most numerically valuable titles are subscription-walled, so open crawling yields headlines and secondary restatements while per-operator ATM/POS fleet shares stay out of reach without a licensed press archive. English-language discovery returns no CZ press at all — only global report vendors — confirming that Czech-language querying is mandatory for this cell.
